description: Medicare levy surcharge (Australia) [AU]. Works out whether an Australian resident pays the Medicare levy surcharge (MLS) for an income year, which tier applies, how much they'd pay, and the yearly hospital-cover premium below which cover is cheaper than the surcharge. Use it for 'do I need private health insurance to avoid the MLS?' questions. Doesn't handle the low-income spouse exemption, part-year couples or dependants, or super lump sums.

daysWithoutCover.description: Days this year without appropriate private hospital cover (default: whole year)
